decks.notes: The central concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly and aggressively dominate the board by playing efficient creatures with strong combat abilities, backed up by burn spells for removal and reach. The deck aims to maintain a low curve and high creature count, with cards like Monastery Swiftspear, Bonecrusher Giant, and Soul-Scar Mage providing early pressure. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds consistency and versatility to the deck. Overall, the key idea is to apply constant pressure and deal damage efficiently to overcome opponents before they can stabilize.

This UW Control deck focuses on creating a board state where the opponent has limited options and resources. By utilizing counterspells, removal spells, and planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria, the deck aims to control the game and outvalue the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Shark Typhoon for additional threats and card advantage. The mana base is optimized to support the control strategy, with lands like Glacial Fortress and Field of Ruin to ensure consistency and disruption. The deck's win condition often comes from incremental advantage and attrition rather than raw aggression.

The deck focuses on controlling the board through a combination of enchantments like Enigmatic Incarnation and Leyline Binding, along with removal spells such as Chained to the Rocks. It also has some powerful creatures like Siege Rhino and Agent of Treachery to apply pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of Fires of Invention allows for casting multiple spells in a turn, while the companion Yorion, Sky Nomad provides additional value by blinking permanents for extra triggers. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent through efficient removal and card advantage.

This deck focuses on aggressive play by utilizing sacrifice synergies and efficient removal spells to control the board and pressure the opponent. The main strategy involves sacrificing creatures like Cauldron Familiar and Bloodtithe Harvester to trigger abilities such as Mayhem Devil's ping effect and generate value from cards like Deadly Dispute. The addition of Jegantha as a companion provides additional value and flexibility. The deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan through targeted discard spells like Thoughtseize and removal spells like Fatal Push.

This white aggro deck focuses on swarming the battlefield with low-cost creatures and pumping them up with anthem effects. It prioritizes fast and aggressive gameplay, overwhelming the opponent with a continuous stream of creatures. The deck also includes protection spells and ways to generate additional creatures to maintain pressure on the opponent. The goal is to quickly build a wide board presence and apply constant pressure to the opponent, forcing them to react defensively in order to win the game.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana with cards like Llanowar Elves and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, while utilizing green devotion cards like Courser of Kruphix to power up cards that care about the number of green mana symbols, such as Old-Growth Troll and Lair of the Hydra. The deck also aims to generate card advantage and provide protection with planeswalkers like Karn, the Great Creator and Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner, while also having big threats like Polukranos Reborn and Cityscape Leveler to close out the game.

The main focus of this deck is to ramp up your mana quickly using cards like Elvish Mystic, Llanowar Elves, Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, and Wolfwillow Haven to power out big threats like Karn, the Great Creator and Cavalier of Thorns. The deck also utilizes green devotion to benefit from cards like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx. Storm the Festival allows you to dig deep for more threats while Lair of the Hydra and Polukranos Unchained provide additional ways to close out the game. The overall strategy is to overwhelm your opponent with powerful creatures and mana advantage.

This deck focuses on creating a strong board presence through early mana acceleration with creatures like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, and using Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx to ramp up into powerful threats like Karn, the Great Creator and Cavalier of Thorns. The key strategy is to generate massive amounts of green mana to cast big creatures and overwhelm the opponent quickly. The deck also utilizes cards like Storm the Festival to dig for more threats and maintain pressure. It aims to be proactive and aggressive in order to win the game quickly.

The main concept of this deck is to ramp up mana quickly using mana dorks like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, as well as powerful lands like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Wolfwillow Haven. The deck then aims to play big threats like Cavalier of Thorns, Old-Growth Troll, and Lair of the Hydra to pressure the opponent. Karn, the Great Creator and Oath of Nissa provide additional utility and card selection, while Storm the Festival allows for digging deeper into the deck for more threats. Overall, this deck seeks to overwhelm the opponent with large, efficient creatures and powerful abilities.

This aggressive Red Deck Wins deck relies on quickly overwhelming opponents with cheap and efficient creatures that deal damage, supported by direct damage spells. The deck features creatures like Monastery Swiftspear, Kari Zev, and Eidolon of the Great Revel, all of which can attack early and deal damage quickly. The spells Lightning Strike and Play with Fire can be used to destroy opposing creatures or directly damage opponents. Torbran, Thane of Red Fell and Kumano Faces Kakkazan amplify the damage output of creatures and spells, while Ramunap Ruins and Den of the Bugbear provide additional sources of damage.

This deck focuses on playing small, efficient creatures and pumping them up with various effects to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Thalia's Lieutenant and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar, the deck aims to build a wide board presence and utilize cards like Brave the Elements to protect its creatures from removal spells. The inclusion of cards like Recruitment Officer and Knight-Errant of Eos helps to maintain card advantage and generate further threats. With an aggressive game plan and a focus on synergy between creatures, this deck aims to establish dominance on the battlefield.

This deck focuses on utilizing Metamorphic Alteration to transform creatures into powerful Archfiend of the Dross, taking advantage of their abilities to control the board and pressure opponents. The deck is designed to disrupt opponent's strategies with a suite of disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Duress, while also leveraging the graveyard with Jace, Vryn's Prodigy and Dig Through Time. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure smooth casting of spells and to support the powerful dual lands and pathways.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with spells, triggering the ability of Arclight Phoenix to return from the graveyard to the battlefield. By including a variety of cheap spells and card draw effects, the deck aims to consistently summon multiple Arclight Phoenixes in a single turn, overwhelming the opponent with a flurry of hasty fliers. The deck also includes cards like Spikefield Hazard and Lightning Axe to control the board and protect the Phoenixes, while Treasure Cruise and Temporal Trespass provide additional card advantage and potential game-ending plays.

The main concept of this deck is to ramp up mana quickly with Llanowar Elves, Elvish Mystic, Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, and Wolfwillow Haven to cast powerful green creatures like Old-Growth Troll and Polukranos Reborn. Karn, the Great Creator and Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner provide additional value and support. Storm the Festival helps to find key creatures while Oath of Nissa helps to filter draws. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with efficient creatures and generate massive amounts of green devotion to take control of the battlefield and secure the victory.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana with cards like Llanowar Elves and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx in order to play powerful green creatures and spells. By utilizing cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner, the deck aims to generate value from its creatures and enchantments. The inclusion of Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll provides strong threats on the board, while cards like Storm the Festival allow the player to search for additional creatures. The overall strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with large creatures and continuous ramp.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive Spirit creatures to control the tempo of the game, disrupting opponents with counterspells and bounce effects while drawing cards with Curious Obsession. The key is to establish a wide board presence quickly and protect your creatures with Spell Queller and Shacklegeist while chipping away at the opponent's life total. Utilizing the versatility of Azorius colors, the deck combines aggressive tempo plays with disruptive elements to outmaneuver and overwhelm the opponent.
